title: Sticky Soy Salmon with Noodles
description: Salmon fillets baked in a sticky soy and honey marinade alongside noodles, pepper, carrot and pak choi.
ingredients: 1 red pepper, deseeded and finely sliced
1 carrot, peeled and cut into thin matchsticks or julienned
1 head of pak choi, leaves separated
MARINADE: 3 tbsp dark soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 2 garlic cloves crushed, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp rice wine vinegar, 1/4 tsp chilli flakes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6. Mix together the marinade ingredients.
Place the salmon fillets on a lined baking tray. Pour half the marinade over the salmon and coat well. Reserve the other half of the marinade.
Meanwhile, in a bowl mix the noodles, pepper, carrot and pak choi with the remaining marinade.
Remove the tray from the oven, push the salmon to one side and add the noodle mixture to the tray. Return to the oven for 8 minutes. Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onions before serving.
notes: Try with tuna steaks or firm white fish instead of salmon. You can add other vegetables such as mangetout, beansprouts or baby corn to the noodle mix.
